smartrefill.configuration.title: Smart Refill Configuration
fml.menu.mods.info.description.smartrefi: Server-side refill after genuine consumption, with optional Accessories totems and Tom wireless storage. Tested with Better MC BMC5 v53. Independent and unaffiliated with the modpack.
smartrefill.configuration.enabled.toolti: Enable genuine-consumption refill on the server.
smartrefill.configuration.useRefill.tool: Refill after right-click use actually exhausts the stack.
smartrefill.configuration.foodRefill.too: Refill an empty slot after eating or drinking; never overwrite a bowl or bottle.
smartrefill.configuration.toolRefill.too: Match the item and every component except damage; replacement must have durability left.
smartrefill.configuration.armorRefill.to: Replace broken armor using the same component rules as tools.
smartrefill.configuration.totemRefill.to: Refill one vanilla totem after actual death protection consumes it.
smartrefill.configuration.accessoryTotem: Refill the original Accessories functional slot after actual totem consumption; requires a compatible totem-use mod such as Accessorify.
smartrefill.configuration.wirelessRefill: Allow Tom wireless network sources. Ordinary terminals require line of sight.
smartrefill.configuration.sourcePriority: Select the first accessible network: inventory, offhand, then Accessories slot name/index. A shortage never switches networks.
smartrefill.configuration.accessoryWirel: Also use valid top-level Accessories functional slots; cosmetic and nested slots are excluded. Tom access rules still apply.
